alt: 同一家植物小店的情況逐步惡化，從盆栽齊全、客人上門，到貨架漸空，最後只剩枯萎植物與愁眉苦臉的店主。
scene_prompt: 每下愈況 means a situation grows progressively worse. Show a clear three-stage progression from left to right in ONE watercolor illustration, separated only by soft ivory space, no panel borders or text. The SAME small unbranded neighborhood plant shop and SAME adult shopkeeper in each stage, recognizable same green apron and short hair. Left stage: many healthy potted plants on full shelves and two customers browsing, shopkeeper mildly worried. Middle stage: fewer plants, several wilted leaves, empty shelf spaces and only one departing customer, shopkeeper more anxious. Right stage largest: almost bare shelves, remaining plants drooping badly, no customers, shopkeeper sits slumped with worried face beside mostly empty coin tray. The gradual decline of shop condition and business must be unmistakable, not seasonal gardening or same-day closing. Small details consistent across stages, same window and table, no calendars, clocks, graphs, arrows, writing, letters or price labels. Figures anatomically coherent, real grounded pots shelves chairs. Gentle child-understandable depiction of worsening fortunes, no disaster or suffering imagery.
